The suit filed by the plaintiff for seeking an order directing the Defendants to quit and deliver the vacant possession of the Schedule Property forthwith, failing COM.O.S.1179/2023 which the Plaintiffs be at liberty to secure the vacant possession of Schedule Property through the process of this court at the cost of the Defendants.

(ii) Directing the Defendant to pay to the Plaintiffs a sum of Rs. 6,55,000/- being the arrears of rent together with current and future interest thereon @ 24% per annum to be computed from the date of institution of suit till the date of payment and that amount be payable from all the Defendants jointly, severally and personally.

(iii) Directing the Defendant for damages to effect payment of a sum of Rs. 2,00,000/- per month or part thereof to the Plaintiffs for the use and occupation of the Schedule Property post the termination of tenancy as "tenants of sufferance" from the date of institution of this suit till the delivery of vacant possession.
The Schedule Property is a commercial property and was leased to the Defendants for commercial purpose to carry on the business of a Restaurant in the name and style of "Khayal".

The present rate of rent payable per month is Rs.1,25,000/.
The area of the Schedule Property is in excess of 14 Square Meters and is in extent of 2580 Square feet.
The Deed of Lease executed by the Plaintiffs in favour of the Defendants is in the custody of the Defendants.
The Schedule Property is being used for commercial purposes and was let out to the Defendants for the purpose of carrying out commercial activity exclusively.
The Defendants are tenants of the Schedule Property on a month to month basis.
